+assignees:

+- 01M0XGPYWHJZSCGFTACTMGCG7M
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: Remove waitSeconds and the two-clock rule from DetachConfiguration
+---
+## What
+The engine must not decide sync-or-background by a timer. The mode is a static property of each tool. Remove the soft clock from the configuration surface in `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/DetachingTool.swift`:
+
+- [ ] Delete `DetachConfiguration.waitSeconds`, `defaultWaitSeconds`, and the `waitSeconds:` init parameter.
+- [ ] Rename `Mode.detaching` to `Mode.background`. Its meaning: every call returns a completion-token handle at once. Keep `Mode.runToCompletion` for fast tools (file edit, skill, discovery — they block and return their value).
+- [ ] Delete the clock-relation rule: `clockRelationFailure(tool:mode:waitSeconds:timeout:)` and `DetachingToolError.invalidClocks(tool:waitSeconds:timeout:)`.
+- [ ] Remove the per-call `waitSeconds` override from `DetachmentParameterProviding`. Keep the per-tool mount declaration (`detachmentMount`) — that is how a tool states its static mode — and keep any per-call `timeout` override.
+- [ ] Keep `timeout` exactly as it is: it bounds the work, every progress event resets it, it suspends while an elicitation is pending, and expiry settles the run as `OperationOutcome.timedOut`. Default stays 120 s for `nativeSessionMount`; a background tool that runs for hours states a long or `nil` timeout.
+
+`nativeSessionMount` keeps its name and becomes `DetachConfiguration(mode: .background)`. `runToCompletionMount` is unchanged. This task changes only the types and configuration; the engine behavior change is the dependent task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `rg 'waitSeconds' Sources` matches only sites the dependent engine task will delete (the race body), or nothing.
+- [ ] `rg 'invalidClocks|clockRelationFailure|defaultWaitSeconds' Sources Tests` returns no match.
+- [ ] `swift build` completes with no error.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update the `DetachConfiguration` tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/DetachingToolTests.swift`: delete the clock-relation cases; add a case that shows `nativeSessionMount.mode == .background`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter DetachingToolTests` — green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #long-running #api
\ No newline at end of file
